read.title: Quotation for Order No. 2417
read.text:
Dear Mr. Kim,

As requested, please find attached our quotation for 3,000 units of the vitamin serum. The unit price is 4.20 US dollars, and the price is valid for 30 days.

Our MOQ is 1,000 units per item, so you may also split the order across three items. Prices are subject to change if the exchange rate moves by more than five percent.

Payment terms are 30 percent in advance and 70 percent before shipment.

Kind regards,
Anna Choi

write.task: 바이어에게 견적서를 보내는 이메일을 써 보세요. 단가, 최소 주문 수량, 가격 유효 기간을 넣으세요.
write.en: Write an email sending a quotation to a buyer, including the unit price, MOQ, and how long the price is valid.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Garcia,

As requested, please find attached our quotation for the hand cream set. The unit price is 3.50 US dollars, and our MOQ is 2,000 units. This price is valid until December 31. Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
